summary: Integrate and recover Git changes while preserving hunk ownership, separating HEAD/index/worktree state, verifying the reviewed tree and detecting destination ref races.
triggers: Git staging and partial hunk ownership in mixed working changes
merge rebase or cherry-pick conflict resolution
reviewed commit tree and working-tree verification mismatch
branch integration after upstream movement or concurrent ref updates
selective Git recovery across repositories worktrees and submodules
antiTriggers: ordinary file editing without Git state or integration concerns
release versioning or changelog planning alone
choosing a universal team branching policy
unauthorized destructive cleanup or history rewriting
